subject: RM_Dripfringe
departures: Dark, smooth fleshy fingers instead of thin grey fibrous strands, leaves or roots
Each finger narrows to a pointed drip-tip with a water droplet hanging from it
Fingers sit side by side in one orderly row from a single base, like an upside-down comb with its teeth pointing down, not a tangled clump
Hangs as a curtain from the lip of a rock overhang or cistern mouth, over a dark opening with a pool of water below
No leaves, stems, flowers or branching anywhere on the fingers
